load_wallet_only_after_explicit_approval.policy: executor MUST load signer/wallet client only after verifying the approval phrase matches the regex and the timestamp is within the last 15 min
preconditions: user-supplied phrase matches ^APPROVE_BASE_10U_LP_PROBE_EXECUTION_ONE_SHOT wallet=0x[0-9a-fA-F]{40} pool=0x[0-9a-fA-F]{40} notional=10 hold=15m$
the same session_id is unique (re-approval produces a new session_id)
wallet_or_tx_touched before this executor = false (in this session)
postconditions: wallet_or_tx_touched = true (after this point the executor is in execution mode)

sign_approve_exact_only_after_explicit_a.policy: executor MUST only sign ERC20.approve(spender=NPM, amount=exact_notional_raw) when needed; amount MUST equal the chosen notional in raw USDC; NEVER uint256.max
preconditions: current USDC.allowance(wallet, NPM) < amount (else skip this action entirely)
postconditions: recorded tx_hash, block_number, gas_used, post-allowance on-chain

sign_mint_only_after_explicit_approval.policy: executor MUST only sign NPM.mint(...) with the locked-in tuple (token0, token1, fee=100, tickLower=-200643, tickUpper=-200243, amount0=0, amount1=10e6, amount0Min=0, amount1Min=9949999, recipient=wallet, deadline=now+3600); MUST NOT change any of these values except deadline which MUST be set to now+3600
preconditions: sign_approve_exact_only completed (or skipped because allowance was sufficient)
postconditions: recorded tokenId, liquidity, actual_token0_deposited, actual_token1_deposited, feeGrowthInside, tokensOwed

sign_decrease_collect_only_within_same_a.policy: executor MUST only sign decreaseLiquidity(tokenId, liquidity=full) and collect(tokenId, recipient=wallet) within the SAME session_id as the mint
postconditions: NPM.positions(tokenId) returns liquidity=0 and tokensOwed=0 after collect

record_token_id.policy: executor MUST record tokenId from the ERC721 Transfer event in the mint tx receipt; this is the primary key for all downstream telemetry

record_actual_fee.policy: executor MUST record feeGrowthInside0/1 at entry and at each hold sample + at exit, to derive actual_position_fee lineage

exit_after_configured_hold.policy: executor MUST exit (Step 4) at end of hold_window OR earlier if any Phase E stop condition triggers

forbidden_actions.no_automatic_repeat: executor MUST NOT loop or schedule another probe; any next probe requires a new approval phrase + new session_id
forbidden_actions.no_multi_pool: executor MUST NOT touch any pool other than the frozen 0x72ab388e..; any other pool requires new spec + new approval
forbidden_actions.no_notional_above_approved: executor MUST NOT increase amount0/amount1 beyond the approved notional; if QuoterV2 requires more for the chosen range, HALT
forbidden_actions.no_approvemax: executor MUST NOT call approve(spender, uint256.max); only ApproveExact
forbidden_actions.no_swap_back: executor MUST NOT swap WETH back to USDC after collect; any swap requires a separate approval
forbidden_actions.no_bridge: executor MUST NOT initiate any cross-chain bridge tx
forbidden_actions.no_live_loop: executor MUST NOT start lpbot-live / lpbot-canary / lpbot-paper; the executor runs as a one-shot script and exits
forbidden_actions.no_background_unattended_trading: executor MUST NOT leave any background process; the script MUST exit after Step 5 or on HALT
forbidden_actions.no_strategy_auto_selection: executor MUST NOT auto-pick a different pool/range/notional; the strategy was decided in this spec
forbidden_actions.no_wallet_reuse_beyond_this_run: executor MUST only sign for this session_id; even if a future 'similar' run is approved, the next run is a new session with new session_id
forbidden_actions.no_hidden_retry: executor MUST NOT silently retry a failed tx; any retry requires a new approval

future_approval_phrase_template.next_stage_where_this_phrase_becomes_eff: LP_BASE_10U_PROBE_EXECUTION_SCRIPT_BUILD_V1 (still not execution; builds the script and another layer of audit)

allowed: load wallet only after explicit approval
sign approve exact only after explicit approval
sign mint only after explicit approval
sign decrease/collect only within same approved probe
forbidden: no wallet reuse beyond this run
